mode: feature repair only; identical v1 cache rows, roles, targets and fit samples
cap_interpretation: fixed engineering assumptions about source observation freshness, not physiological action duration or tuned thresholds
age_reference: issue time minus latest source timestamp available under v1 channel delay
missing_age: preserve NaN; unobserved flag true; stale flag false
stale_rule: age strictly greater than cap; cap numeric age and mask latest_observed only; retain existing window amounts/counts/fractions
cgm_policy: unchanged: v1 admission already bounds age and recent maximum gap by native cadence
models: same fixed Ridge and delta XGBoost configurations as v1
diagnostics: cadence, current and predicted glucose bins, actual low/high slices, recent slope, input age buckets and delta variance ratios; descriptive, not selection
